text:
Sam K: Thinking out loud — can we darklaunch v2 routing for 10% of traffic but make quota attribution and billing show up as v1 until cutoff?
Marta P: We can, but need clear telemetry so customers don't see surprising spikes when we flip. Darklaunch should tag requests with X-Compat-Dark=true and route, but attribution to v1 for billing is tricky.
Neal R: Agree. If we keep billing under v1, console needs a separate 'darklaunch usage' panel. Otherwise finance will get angry.
Jessie L: What metrics do we want? Minimal: total requests, avg latency, errors, token-ops, and a compatibility acceptance rate. Something like compat.dark_accept_rate and compat.intent_mismatch_count.
Sam K: Exactly. Also need a way to detect behavioral regressions — e.g., rerank divergence or hallucination rate. Might be eval-set matches over time.
Marta P: For rollout UX, propose: on the Route config page show a single toggle "Darklaunch v2" with a percent slider. Hover states explain: "Traffic still billed to v1; darklaunch metrics are in the sidecar panel."
Neal R: If we bill to v1, quota enforcement must still count against the tenant's v1 quota buckets. Implementation: route decision chooses instance (v2) but incrementQuota(tenant, v1_quota_key). That keeps billing stable.
Sam K: Careful — some customers expect per-model billing. We need to map v2 -> v1 compatible model IDs in the mapping table.
Jessie L: Console telemetry needs to expose both: live darklaunch feed + anomaly alerts if dark_accept_rate < 85% or error rate delta > 2x baseline. Also surface when mapped-quota consumption diverges by >5% from observed tokens (possible double-counting).
Marta P: How should we surface deprecation notices during darklaunch? We don't want permanent banners. Maybe ephemeral banner with "This route is in darklaunch: v2 will become default on DATE. Preview metrics link."
Neal R: Ops concern: when darklaunch percentage changes quickly, backend should gracefully backpressure. Recommend circuit-breaker: if p95 latency for dark cohort > SLO*1.3 or errors spike, auto-reduce percent by half and fire a rollout alert.
Sam K: +1. Need a lightweight telemetry signal for the auto-reducer so we can audit it later. Name it rollout.autoreduce.reason and include tags: {route, tenant, metric}.
Jessie L: For telemetry schema, propose these new tags/metrics: ["compat.dark_pct","compat.dark_accept_rate","compat.mapped_quota_tokens","compat.eval_match_rate","rollout.autoreduce.count","rollout.autoreduce.reason"]
Marta P: Can we add a small console graph that overlays v1-billed tokens vs actual tokens consumed by dark requests? That will let SEs reassure customers.
Neal R: Implementation sketch (pseudo):
```
if (isDarklaunched(request)) {
  routeTo(model_v2);
  incrementQuota(tenant, mapToV1Quota(model_v2)); // billing only
  emitMetric("compat.dark_accept_rate", accepted?1:0);
}
```
Sam K: That snippet helps. Who owns the mapping table? Should be runtime-config owned by eng-platform with a simple API so model-onboarding can declare mapToV1Quota.
Marta P: Yeah. Runtime-config + validation in model catalog. Also we need a dashboard tile in "Route Health" linking to darklaunch audit logs for the last 72 hours.
Jessie L: Ops question: how do we prevent telemetry gaps during rollout changes? If we switch percent flags very frequently, sampling could miss important regressions. Suggest minimum sample window of 10 minutes and a sampling seed so logs are consistent.
Neal R: Deploy-bot: rollout flag updated by feature-flag service. We'll add a guard to prevent >20% change in <5m without explicit override. :gear:
deploy-bot: Guard added to FF service: maxStep=20, minWindow=300s.
Sam K: Nice. Next steps: eng-platform to prototype mapping API and metrics emission; devex to design the darklaunch panel copy; eng-sre to define autoreduce thresholds.
Marta P: I'll create the console mock and add copy for ephemeral banners. Assigning: Marta (console mock), Neal (quota mapping & guard impl), Jessie (telemetry schema & alerts), Sam (product doc + rollout plan).
Jessie L: Linking proposed metric names to datadog dashboards and alerts in the ticket. I'll post dash mocks shortly.
Neal R: One more note: we should avoid stealth-deprecations. Even in darklaunch, update the model catalog with deprecation ETA and a "preview" label so customers can opt into seeing it in their usage reports.
Sam K: Sounds good. If no objections I’ll spin up the RFC and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Marta P: No objections from me.
Jessie L: SGTM.
Neal R: SGTM.
Sam K: RFC created: https://rfc.internal/redwood/darklaunch-v2-compat (internal)
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for feature flag changes window tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
